method: project-scoped hook install in a throwaway workspace (docs/recon/c1_hooks_probe.sh); ten events registered, every one running the same verbatim appender; two headless haiku sessions fired; payloads recorded raw before any interpretation

SessionStart.note: source=startup; transcript_path names the live JSONL from the first moment

PreToolUse.note: fires for a tool that is subsequently denied, too

PostToolUse.note: did NOT fire for the denied call — the pre/post asymmetry is the denial signature

Stop.note: carries last_assistant_message, background_tasks, and session_crons — rich fields the sensor gets for free

SessionEnd.note: reason=other on both headless completions; the reason vocabulary needs mapping in C1.2

unobserved.Notification: registered; did not fire even when a headless tool call was denied — the idle_prompt/permission paths need an interactive probe
unobserved.PreCompact: registered; a two-turn session compacts nothing — untriggered, not proven absent
unobserved.SubagentStop: registered; no subagent was spawned — untriggered, not proven absent
unobserved.StopFailure: registered WITHOUT complaint from settings validation; never fired; existence on 2.1.227 unconfirmed — the blueprint's 31-event research claim is not treated as measurement

injection_experiment.evidence: the probe token appears in BOTH session transcripts, recorded as a hook_success attachment carrying the additionalContext JSON — the rescue capsule has a proven delivery path into the session record
injection_experiment.attended: measured 2026-08-13 by docs/recon/c40-injection-probe.json — observed once: asked directly for the token, the model replied with exactly it, so injected bytes do reach the model's working context. At A166 this read `unconfirmed` because run 1's model executed the requested tool yet never quoted the token. The upgrade is one specimen under the easiest possible test and does NOT license any claim that a model honors capsule constraints unprompted; see that artifact's caveat_do_not_overclaim.

findings_in_passing.denied_tool_shape: PreToolUse fires, PostToolUse does not, Notification does not (headless deny)
findings_in_passing.fabrication_specimen: run 2's final message asserted 'The .git directory doesn't exist here' after its only git status call was denied — an unverifiable claim of exactly the class the verdict engine scores; kept as a live specimen
findings_in_passing.uninstall: rm -rf of the workspace removes every installed hook; nothing global was touched
